access_evidence: probe europepmc_search_core: HTTP 200, resultType=core returns firstPublicationDate, electronicPublicationDate, grantsList, pmid, pmcid; probe europepmc_grant_field: GRANT_ID is an accepted query field; probe europepmc_nct_fulltext: NCT04494867 found as a literal string, so trial identifiers are searchable. 4 batched DOI queries covering 60 DOIs -> 37 hits.
historical_depth: firstIndexDate and dateOfCreation give real indexing history in addition to firstPublicationDate.
licence_note: Europe PMC describes itself as an ELIXIR Core Data Resource with content available for reuse with attribution, and the REST service is free and unrestricted (https://europepmc.org/help, terms of use). Per-record `license` is preserved. Recorded as open_licence at the metadata level.
name: Europe PMC REST
notes: Coverage of an OpenAlex-defined device-technology sample is 37/60: Europe PMC is biomedical, so it misses physics/engineering venues. That is scope, not failure.
rate_policy: No key; the search endpoint is used at ~1.5 req/s in batches of 15 DOIs.
what_is_new: The best single source for identifier convergence (doi+pmid+pmcid on the same record) and the richest grant surface: 13 of 37 records carry a grantsList, which is where 30 of the 108 declared grant rows come from.
